subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: What diagnostic contract should workspace discovery use when package.json or HOOK.md exceeds the new 1 MiB limit?
rationale: The limit is a valid hardening measure, but it can disable an existing hook during upgrade; choosing whether that is silent, warning-level, or fatal is a user-visible compatibility decision rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Continue discovering other hooks while emitting one actionable warning that identifies the oversized metadata path and limit.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Keep discovery available without new log noise, accepting that an existing oversized hook may disappear without an actionable explanation.

options.title: Fail discovery
options.body: Surface the oversized file as a hard validation error, maximizing visibility but allowing one hook package to interrupt the broader discovery workflow.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Continue discovering other hooks while emitting one actionable warning that identifies the oversized metadata path and limit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work connects the hook workspace module with the shared boundary-reader infrastructure and compatibility-sensitive runtime behavior.
